semantic_fragments.content: Alternative means based scientific data or clinical opinion or comparative studies: No alternative means used (N/A). This applies to IEC60601-1 Clause 4.6 context regarding RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS and APPLIED PARTS identification.

For Clause 4.8, the reliability of components used as MEANS OF PROTECTION shall be assessed for conditions of use in ME EQUIPMENT, and they shall comply with one of the following: a) Applicable safety requirements of a relevant IEC or ISO standard; b) Requirements of this standard applied in the absence of a relevant IEC or ISO standard. Results are documented in appended table 8.10.
The ME EQUIPMENT uses an internal power supply (Clause 4.10.1 verdict: P). It is not connected to SUPPLY MAINS, making clauses 4.10.2 and 4.11 (power input measurements) not applicable (N/A).
